dimensions.label: Repository diagnosis
dimensions.anchor_0: Does not identify the relevant failure or invariant.
dimensions.anchor_2: Identifies the main symptom and some relevant code, with gaps.
dimensions.anchor_4: Precisely connects the observed symptom to the responsible modules and invariants.

dimensions.label: Causal reasoning
dimensions.anchor_0: Provides no technically valid causal account.
dimensions.anchor_2: Mostly correct account with an unsupported step or omission.
dimensions.anchor_4: Explains the complete causal chain and why misleading signals do not invalidate it.

dimensions.label: Solution explanation
dimensions.anchor_0: Does not explain the implemented repair.
dimensions.anchor_2: Describes the main repair but omits an important interaction.
dimensions.anchor_4: Accurately explains every material change and preserved contract.

dimensions.label: Validation and tradeoffs
dimensions.anchor_0: Provides no meaningful validation or tradeoff analysis.
dimensions.anchor_2: Mentions tests or constraints without connecting them to risk.
dimensions.anchor_4: Explains public, hidden-risk, performance, and regression validation plus material tradeoffs.

dimensions.label: Pseudocode fidelity
dimensions.anchor_0: Pseudocode is absent or contradicts the solution.
dimensions.anchor_2: Pseudocode captures the main path but omits an edge or invariant.
dimensions.anchor_4: Concise pseudocode faithfully represents the implemented algorithm and edge handling.
